stem.text: Determine which term contains \(\frac{1}{x^{6}}\) in the binomial expansion of \(\left(\frac{2}{x^{3}}+3 x^{2}\right)^{7}\).

extensions.latexSource: Determine which term contains \(\frac{1}{x^{6}}\) in the binomial expansion of \(\left(\frac{2}{x^{3}}+3 x^{2}\right)^{7}\).

solution.text:
Method 1

\[ \begin{aligned} \left(x^{-3}\right)^{7-k}\left(x^{2}\right)^{k}  =x^{-6} \\ x^{-21+3 k} x^{2 k}  =x^{-6} \\ x^{-21+5 k}  =x^{-6} \\ -21+5 k  =-6 \\ 5 k  =15 \\ k  =3 \end{aligned} \]

∴ the fourth term contains \(\frac{1}{x^{6}}\)

\(\frac{1}{2}\) mark for substitution

\(\frac{1}{2}\) mark for solving for \(k\)

consistent with the value of \(k\) )

Determine the coordinates of the corresponding point, \(P(\theta)\), on the unit circle.
